notes: Workbench Landing binds to scalar landing/status, section and presenter action rows so the first screen is immediately presenter-ready.
Workbench Hub targets are generated by Cernion; Budibase renders scalar display rows for navigation and readiness only.
Selected Hub Target binds to scalar selected/focus/helper rows so presenters can open a Workbench section without Budibase becoming the state owner.
Administrator Inventory binds to scalar rows that separate public context, synthetic seed, sandbox runtime, generated workbench items and read/verify runbooks.
Tenant Databrowser binds to bounded scalar category, item, trace, detail and source rows; it is not an unrestricted export or Budibase-owned data store.
Selected Case Evidence and Next Gates bind to scalar rows so tables do not render nested objects.
Sandbox Case Annotation uses a curated Cernion POST command plus scalar readback/audit rows; Budibase never writes arbitrary tables or owns case state.
Selected-case action rows are curated read-only/verify-only button metadata; Budibase may refresh queries but must not write arbitrary Cernion tables.

Curated Action Button Contract rows expose ROLE_NETZPLANUNG buttons for smm-budibase-workbench: only refresh_read_model, verify_blueprint_seed and validate_evidence_completeness are enabled; sandbox annotation and operational actions stay disabled with scalar reasons.
Demo Process Panel rows show safe verify actions, disabled operational actions, last known results and Cernion/Rundeck boundaries without executing jobs.
Role Workbench Catalog binds to scalar role/open-target rows for Administrator, Zielnetzplanung, Vertrieb, Key Account and VDMI governance views.
Zielnetzplanung Role Queue binds to scalar queue and evidence-handover rows for the generated grid-planning target.
Selected Zielnetzplanung Item binds to scalar summary, context, evidence-gap, next-gate and safe-follow-up rows; it is advisory evidence context, not a grid-capacity approval.
Vertrieb Briefing binds to scalar evidence-backed claim, evidence, gap and internal follow-up rows; unsupported claims stay not-yet-claimable.
MaStR Revalidation binds to scalar public-context, overlay asset, affected-case, next-gate, safe-action and boundary rows; synthetic drill rows are never represented as real public MaStR changes.
Kommunalwert / Peer-Korridor binds to existing municipal-energy-value-analysis read rows for Mauer, Sandhausen and Wiesloch; Budibase renders scalar presenter evidence only.
Municipal peer-corridor rows keep direct municipal budget effect separate from operator/private value and label derived load evidence as not measured.
No-autarky guardrails and missing evidence gates stay visible for presenters; Budibase may refresh queries but must not make public supply, household-equivalent or autarky claims.
Controlled Action runStadtwerkMauerE2ESmoke remains scope-protected by Cernion.

VDMI Profile and Synthetic Event Preview bind to existing dashboard read models with scalar role, capability, evidence, preview and no-call rows; Budibase refreshes queries only and never injects or executes synthetic events.

Evidence Freshness binds to the existing evidence-freshness-guard read model with synthetic Stadtwerk Mauer signal metadata; Budibase renders scalar freshness, delta, evidence-gap and no-call rows only.

Blueprint Verify binds to the existing operations-runbook verify wrapper and renders scalar summary, matrix-sync, data-class, required-evidence, role-relation, next-gate and no-call rows for stadtwerk-mauer-substation-load-assessment-v1.

Blueprint Seed Selector binds to the existing Blueprint-Pack verify and transfer-readiness facades for the two canonical Stadtwerk-Mauer seeds; Budibase renders selector, matrix, evidence, data-class, sync-status and cross-system variance linkout rows as scalar read-only cells.

Transfer Readiness binds to a read-only dashboard facade that separates public context, synthetic seed values, sandbox runtime artifacts, tenant parameters, reusable Workbench elements and blocked production boundaries.

VNB Delta / Signal Queue binds to existing classifier, queue, owner/deadline/evidence and leadership delta read models with synthetic caller-supplied signals; Budibase renders scalar operator rows and no-call guards only.

Portfolio Market Value Readiness binds Blueprint-Pack verify rows for stadtwerk-mauer-portfolio-market-value-readiness-v1 with a synthetic portfolio-backtest query; Budibase renders scalar demo-readiness, plausibility, evidence-gap and non-advice rows only.

Portfolio review rows stay read-only/generated: no portfolio persistence, trading, investment advice, external connector, billing, settlement, tariff, MaKo, device-control, Budibase table write or Personal-Agent execution is allowed.
Budibase renders the workbench; Cernion remains the system of record and command gate.
